rules.rationale: Stock codes/invoices contain trailing spaces and mixed case ('47503J ', 'm'); without normalisation the same SKU is counted twice.
Both yearly sheets contain 2010-12-01..2010-12-09. Naive concatenation double-counts those orders, inflating frequency and monetary features.

Identical lines (same invoice, SKU, quantity, timestamp, price, customer) are system double-scans; they inflate quantities and basket co-occurrence. Description is not part of the key (spelling variants of one SKU).
Invoices prefixed 'C' are reversals, not purchases. Kept in a separate table used only as a point-in-time feature; never netted (netting leaks future events).
Invoices prefixed 'A' are accounting adjustments ('Adjust bad debt').
Non-cancellation lines with quantity <= 0 are stock write-offs/damages ('lost', 'damaged', '?') with no customer.
Price <= 0 lines are free samples or manual corrections; they are not sales and would distort monetary features.
Postage, carriage, manual, bank/Amazon fees, test and gift-voucher codes are not products: they would dominate baskets ('recommend postage') and skew category mix.
The same SKU appears under several spellings; one canonical label per stock code keeps the rule engine and catalogue consistent.

Lines above the 99.9% quantile of quantity (520) or line revenue (734.40) — e.g. the 80,995-unit error — are flagged and revenue is capped for features instead of dropped (they are real orders but not representative). Caps are estimated on pre-validation data only.

rules.rule: R10 null customer id (Head A view)
rules.rationale: Guest checkouts cannot be attributed to a customer, so they are excluded from the retention table (Head A) but kept for basket mining (Head B) where the invoice is the unit.
